dev_acceptance_suite_v2_6_baseline.description: 25 internal exploratory DEV acceptance cases evaluated under historical Evaluator v2.6
dev_acceptance_suite_v2_6_baseline.epistemic_qualification: Historical baseline error envelope of Evaluator v2.6 before v2.7 linguistic remediation

discrepancies.cause: Naive '-s' inflection heuristic treated base verb 'bypass' (ending in '-ss') as 3rd-person inflected verb
Evaluator conditional regex accepted non-inverted 'If' distractor as valid, declaring distractor ambiguity
Evaluator failed to detect multi-option base form ambiguity when carrier clauses diverged in subject noun phrasing
Prompt used adjective 'mandative' without base trigger 'mandate', bypassing mandative validator

evaluator_v2_7_remediation.description: Remediated evaluator v2.7 tested against the 25 diagnostic DEV acceptance cases

resolved_defects.remediation: Verb-inflection filter updated to recognize base verbs ending in -ss (bypass, cross, discuss, assess, dismiss) and -eed as valid bare infinitives
Conditional validator updated with stem inversion constraint: non-inverted 'if' options disqualified as distractors when prompt specifies inverted conditional
Robust subjunctive subordinate clause parsing extracts base forms (pay, appear) across diverse carrier and subject structures, correctly detecting multi-option ambiguity
Mandative triggers expanded to include grammatical terms (mandative, subjunctive) and carrier verbs, detecting defective MCQs with zero base forms

evaluator_v2_7_remediation.inconclusive_handling: Genuinely inconclusive grammar cases yield EvaluationVerdict.UNCERTAIN rather than unsupported PASS or FAIL
evaluator_v2_7_remediation.epistemic_qualification: While Evaluator v2.7 achieves 100% concordance on the 25 diagnostic DEV cases, in-sample calibration does not prove generalizability; confirmatory quality acceptance remains pending the independent, uninspected human holdout

failures.stem: Pyroclastic fragmentation occurs in deep benthic environments due to high hydrostatic pressure.
failures.original_abstention_reason: FALSE contradiction: passage affirms proposition without contradiction
failures.linguistic_rationale: Passage states hydrostatic pressure suppresses volatile exsolution, thereby preventing pyroclastic fragmentation. Statement asserts it occurs due to pressure. Generator proposed FALSE, which is contextually and factually correct. Evaluator contradiction regex failed on 'preventing'.

failures.stem: Pyroclastic fragmentation is common in deep benthic environments.
failures.original_abstention_reason: FALSE contradiction: passage affirms proposition without contradiction
failures.linguistic_rationale: Passage states fragmentation is prevented. A phenomenon prevented cannot be common. Generator proposed FALSE, which is correct.

failures.stem: TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN: Pillow lava forms when basaltic magma erupts into seawater at depths exceeding 200 atmospheres.
failures.original_abstention_reason: Entailment contradiction: passage contradicts TRUE statement
failures.linguistic_rationale: Conflates physical pressure (atmospheres) with ocean depth (meters). Sentence 1 mentions abyssal depths; Sentence 5 mentions pressure exceeding 200 atmospheres. Passage does not support that pillow lava erupts 'at depths exceeding 200 atmospheres'. Proposed answer TRUE is factually defective.
